question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The incorrect spelling is: **"Abodomen"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Abodomen"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Abdomen".**
 
• **Correct Word:** Abdomen
 
 
• **Meaning (English): **It refers to a part of the body. (पेट)
 
• **Example:** He felt a sharp pain in his abdomen after eating spoilt food.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**
